about: Who may receive enhancements from tables whose text is not simply 'HERO only'. Transcribed from each table's description in the Wahapedia export (Faction_ability_types / Faction_ability_subtypes). Key: '<faction id>|<table name>'. Fields: hero (true = HERO only, false = non-HERO only), all (every keyword required), any (at least one), not (none of), names (warscroll names), excludeNames. Keywords are matched against warscroll keywords, case-insensitive.

BoK|Brazen Mutations.text: non-Hero Blades of Khorne Infantry or Cavalry units

CoS|Decorations for Valour.text: Cities of Sigmar units that have the CHAMPION keyword

CoS|Sentinels of Order.text: HERO only, excluding Cannonade Cogfort and Conqueror Cogfort

CoS|Treasures of the Cities.text: HERO only, excluding Cannonade Cogfort and Conqueror Cogfort

DoT|Visions of Fate.text: non-Hero non-Beast Disciples of Tzeentch units

FE|Noble Pursuits.text: non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts Infantry or Cavalry units

HS|All-Consuming Obsessions.text: non-Hero Hedonites of Slaanesh Infantry or Cavalry units

NT|Crimes of the Condemned.text: non-Hero Nighthaunt Infantry or Cavalry units

SoB|Realm-Shaking Rampages.text: non-UNIQUE BIG units (одна Realm-shaking Rampage на юнит)

StD|Brands of the Dark Gods.text: non-Hero Slaves to Darkness Infantry units

StD|Ensorcelled Banners.text: Slaves to Darkness Infantry and Cavalry units with the STANDARD BEARER keyword
